applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (All India Financial Institutions (AIFIs) – Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Fifth Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Apply a 2 per cent risk weight to trade exposures to QCCPs for OTC derivatives, exchange-traded derivatives, and SFTs as specified.
answer.action_quote: Where an AIFI acts as a clearing member of a QCCP for its own purposes, a risk weight of 2 per cent shall be applied to the AIFI’s trade exposure to the QCCP

effective_date.quote: These Amendment Directions shall come into effect from the date of issue.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India ( All India Financial Institutions (AIFIs) - Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Directions, 2025
